description: SceneTrees mid-swap oracle: every trace-oracle case (and 1M rays at seams, plain and transformed) on GPU H-PLOC trees, half swapped to tinybvh, and all tinybvh, with gpuTreeOutputs copy and adopt and mergeStaticInstances off and on; the GPU walk over the GPU top level must match the CPU-assembled scene, and rays that must hit must hit.
